notes.title: Frontline Fury - Trenches, Mud & Blood Demo OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
The battle begins now! The demo for Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood is officially live on Steam! Step into the boots of a soldier fighting in the gritty, war-torn battlefields of World War II, where every moment is a fight for survival.

[list]
[*] Intense Top-Down Combat – Experience the chaos of war with brutal, fast-paced gameplay.
[*] Survive the Trenches – Navigate the mud-soaked battlefields, dodge artillery fire, and take cover in the trenches.
[*] Tactical Shooting – Every bullet counts. Choose your weapons wisely and adapt to the fight.
[*] Relentless Warfare – Face waves of enemy soldiers in intense, high-stakes combat scenarios.
[/list]

Inspired by real WWII battles, Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood delivers an action-packed experience where quick reflexes and strategic thinking determine survival. Can you withstand the horrors of war and complete your mission?

[h3]The fight starts now – download the demo and join the frontline![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522060/Frontline_Fury__Trenches_Mud__Blood_Demo/][b]Play the Demo on Steam[/b][/url]

notes.title: Moonshine Maniacs will become free2play ...
notes.notes:
It's 2 months since we released our first Indie game Moonshine Maniacs on steam and to be honest, we thought it would run better. So one of the biggest issues of MSM is the lack of players and to solve this, we had two options ...

1. Spend more money into advertisement
2. Make it free2play

We want people to see what we wanted to do here, we don't want to compete with other big titles or strongly known PVP games. All we aimed for was having a good time where you can relax and shoot some cowboys between the eyes. Of course, it's kind of an old school thinking of games, but its what we ourselves enjoy from time to time.

So our next step will wait if we can build a community who likes moonshine maniacs and see if we can work further on it, to move it there where we wanted it to be.

So if you feel to keep yourself up to date and look for someone to compete with, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/yZ6GKv5]Discord[/url].

See you at highnoon, cowboy! :D

notes.title: Moonshine Maniacs got released!
notes.notes:
We are proud to invite you all to our first multiplayer shooter Moonshine Maniacs. Finally we can share the joy and fun ride of our initial project. It was quite a good journey to develop our first old-school arena shooter for steam.

[previewyoutube=UdTX6ZECG-s;full][/previewyoutube]

We have taken the challenge to push a small projects to a state where we enjoy playing it ourself and where we can be proud to show what we would you like to experience. Moonshine Maniacs is a mix of old and modern shooter and can maybe fill the one or other hour in your free-time.

But the journey will not end here, we are hoping to build a community with you. Develop new modes, maps and weapons ... we want the Moonshine to light up and set a small fire with a loyal community that shares our interest in making games. 

If you are interested in being part of this little ride, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/yZ6GKv5]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think of the game. 

Happy shooting! :)

notes.title: New weapons and skins added
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
the release is close and we are getting some new sexy stuff in it. We are working to polish the gunplay even more. Adding new weapons and a lot of skins to the game. We are excited to see the first people taking some wild west duel online and compete against each other.

First of all, we added the first/ burst pistol in the game. It will be one of the most dangerous guns out of the wild wild west and we are looking forward how people will try to counter them. Can you compete against a super fast shooting Revolver?
